prompts.head: Use case stylized-concept. Production close-up turntable design for MagicDesk optical curator robot head. Reference image provides character identity and materials. Correct an inadequate 3D implementation. Four equal panels: hero close-up with friendly attentive face, three-quarter rear showing loadbearing neck connection, cutaway mechanism exposing six curved iris blades and their pin slots/rotating drive ring, full small optical tonearm and its lift piston/socket close-up. High-end precision collectible AAA game prop, Atomic Heart-inspired retrofuturist porcelain and champagne nickel-gold. The head is round, slightly pear-shaped, gentle oversized lens face; two expressive warm amber pixel eyes inside dark smoked optical glass, tiny playful asymmetry, actual curved black metal iris blades encircling the eyes. Thin stepped metallic lens bezel with finely machined edge and minimal engraved tick marks, not a big flat golden disk. Double-cheek clevis connects the forearm endpoint to a full-width transverse axle in the head's neck; no isolated sphere with a thin disconnected stick. Independent down-projector hangs from its own rounded stable cradle behind/below the character so tilting the head cannot tilt carried media. Small optical reading probe faces down toward a record, has a continuous sculpted porcelain arm and a real telescopic lift piston which remains seated in its outer sleeve at maximum lift. Structural joints have bearings, shaft shoulders, retaining collars, lubricant seals, fasteners and continuous black cable guide, but not excess greeble. Same head every panel. Tiny panel titles only: CHARACTER, CONNECTION, IRIS, READER. Neutral charcoal studio with large softbox reflections showing smooth glaze and metal curvature. No base re-design, no huge cannon, no antenna ears, no claw fingers. Actual design sheet not a claim of engineering verification.
prompts.faces: Generate a production emissive texture atlas for a cute retrofuturist mechanical AI camera face. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, all against pure BLACK. No borders, headings, captions, letters, numbers or hardware. Each cell is the same face position/size: two large eye glyphs, white monochrome intensity (runtime will tint amber), crisply constructed from discrete rounded luminous micro-pixels with black gaps. NOT tiny text art. Avoid bloom beyond one pixel so silhouettes remain readable. The face occupies middle 65% of every cell. Row one left-to-right: attentive large friendly vertical oval eyes with small highlight cutouts; curious face one eye wide oval one short squint; delighted two upward crescent eyes; working focused half-lidded narrow eyes. Row two left-to-right: surprised round eyes; drowsy drooping eyes; asleep two gently curved closed-eye lines; proud one playful wink and one upturned crescent. Emotion must be obvious even at thumbnail size. No eyebrows outside face, no mouths, no decorative stars, no heart icons. Stable eye centers in all eight cells for crossfading animations. Flat orthographic bitmap texture, each tile separate, pure black surrounding glyphs.
